buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.

3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA File Attachment Click here to view the file. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Guideline, Terms & Condition Buyer Added Text 1. Availability of Office: Office should be in the state of consignee i.e. Andhra Pradesh, Visakhapatn am. Valid documentary evidence should be submitted as proof. 2. Registration: The Bidder should be registered with the Income Tax, Goods and Service Tax and also re gistered under the labour laws, Employees Provident Fund Organisation, Employees State Insurance Corpo ration. In proof of having fully adhered to minimum eligibility criteria as mentioned above, attested copy of PA N, GST Registration, EPF Registration, ESIC Registration and Labour Licence shall only be acceptable. 3. Clearance: The Bidder should also have clearance from GST, and Income Tax Department. The firm s hould produce valid GST Certificate, Valid Labour Registration Certificate of Consignee locatio n i.e. (Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh) failing to which the firm is liable for rejection. 4. Experience: The Bidder should have at least 03 years of experience for providing manpower services i n Ministries / Departments under Government of India. In proof of having fully adhered to minimum eligibili ty criteria as mentioned above, attested copy of work orders alongwith work completion certificates / ongoi ng work certificates issued by the Ministries / Departments under Government of India shall be acceptable . 5. Turnover: The Bidder should have minimum gross turnover in the similar business of providing manpo wer as per the bid document. In proof of having fully adhered to minimum eligibility criteria as mentioned a bove, attested copy of the audited balance sheets (audited by Chartered Accountant) for the completed thr ee financial year i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 shall only be acceptable. 6. Service Charge: - Minimum service charges should be (3.85%) percentage and above.

7. Police Verification: Police Verification of Contractual employees should be done by the service provid er who is directly responsible for the action of their employees after awarding of contract. 8. Language: The service provider will ensure that the staff employed is conversant and understands Eng lish or Hindi Language. 9. This Service will be provided in CGDHQ-6, Visakhapatnam. 10. Self-Declaration: That Contractor has not been suspended or blacklisted by any Unit/ Office of Indian Coast Guard, any other PSU or Govt. Agency and submit a declaration as follows: (i) “I/We hereby declare that I/we have not been Banned/ Suspended/ Blacklisted or de-l isted by any PSU/ Government Department/ Financial Institution / Court.” In case, the de claration is found incorrect/false at any later stage, the tender is liable to be rejected, the contract shall be closed without any further notice and Incident will be raise as per GeM Terms and Conditio ns. (ii) I/We hereby declare that I/We have quoted service Charge 3.85% and above as per terms & condition of Bid Document. 11. Registered Local Office: The Registered Office of participating firm is required to be located in cons ignee location to co-ordinate the services uninterrupted and to resolve any issues arising while carrying ou t contract as per contractual obligations. In support the service provider has to submit documentary proof of office address, with landline/ mobile number of the contact person failing which the bid offer will be reje cted during technical evaluation. 12. Performance Guarantee: The Bidder will be required to furnish a performance guarantee certificate by way of Bank Guarantee/ FDR through Public or Private Sector banks authorised to conduct government business of a total sum of 3% of the contract value. 13. Paying Authority: No advance payment will be done, payment will be made on monthly basis throu gh CDA (N), Vizag. 14. Unsatisfactory Performance: The Service provider is also likely to be rejected in case of unsatisfact ory past performance in previous or ongoing contracts. 15. Financial Position. The firm should have a sound financial position to continue to provide s ervice for a period of minimum of three months irrespective of clearance of bills by paying aut hority due to want of correct documents from service provider or any other unforeseen reason s. The payment should be made within one week of receiving attendance sheet from the buyer failing which the incident will be raised on GeM. 16. Firms should fill the certificates duly attached in the ATC and upload along with the other bid documen ts for technical evaluation. Firms falling to do so are liable for rejection. 17. Firms not replying to queries based on technical bids within the specified time will be rejected.

18. Submission of escalation matrix document for service support is to be submitted as per format upload ed in the bid along with the other technical documents. 19. Bid Security Declaration: Bidders to sign a Bid securing declaration on firm’s letter head accepting that if they withdraw or modify their bids during the period of validity or if they are awarded the contract a nd they fail to sign the contract or to submit a performance security before the deadline defined in the req uest for bids document they will be suspended for the period of one year (time specified in the request for bids document) from being eligible to submit bids for contracts with entity that invited the bids. The bid de claration as per format be submitted along with other technical documents. 20. Non-Disclosure Declaration Certificate. Non-Disclosure declaration certificate are to be submitted as p er the format uploaded in the bid along with other documents. 21. Duty Hours: - Duty hours of drivers will be 26 days and 12 hours per day on rotational basis. 22. The firm should produce valid GST Certificate of Consignee location i.e. (Andhra Pradesh, V isakhapatnam) failing to which the firm is liable for rejection. 23. Replacement to be provided by the contractor within 03 working days. 24. This Headquarters is proposed to opt the option via GeM portal only to choose L1 firm through “Manua l selection” if available in place of “L1 run by the system” at the time of final selection. 25. In case of any accidents/injuries to the driver, the entire responsibility lie with seller. 26. Drivers: The contractor shall ensure that the antecedents of the drivers are verified by the police and they are in possession of the same while on duty. The drivers should be well turned out in khaki / safari dr ess with black shoe. Following are mandatory conditions for drivers employed for MTD duties are to be ens ured by the contractor: a. All drivers must be in possession of smart turn out with neat and clean uniform while on duty. b. All drivers should be in possession of valid HMV driving license and with minimum experience of thr ee years. c. All drivers should be in possession of working mobile phone while on duty and adhere to the securit y norms in ICG/ other defence organisation. (d) Drivers are required to be disciplined and behave properly. The contractor shall withdraw such driver found indulge in any disciplinary cases and provide relief within three working days. (e) Drivers should not consume alcohol and chew tobacco on duty hours.

(f) It is desirable that the drivers having knowledge of Hindi/English. (g) The driver is required to be well versed with routes in and around Vishakhapatnam. (h) The second party can change the driver with prior notice to the first party in advance. Frequent change of drivers, employment of drivers with inadequate knowledge of road/ offices etc. may resu lt in penalty and amount as deemed fit may be deducted from the bills/PBG. (j) The drivers employed by the second party will not be having any right of access at his own, to a ny of the Indian Coast Guard or other Military installations, Defence areas or any other central/ go vt. premises/offices where general access to outsiders are prohibited. Driver’s attempt to access in to any unauthorized place/ rooms of above office will be deemed as security breach and will empo wer any such offices to take suitable penal action against the defaulting driver. (k) The drivers employed by second party will not attempt to secure any information about any def ence/ Govt. installation/ officials/operations under cover of being on ICG duty. (l) Any item (Personal/Govt. property) found by drivers in the vehicle, after use by ICG personnel to be reported/ handed over by the drivers to MT Section/ guard room/security staff of CGDHQ-6/conc erned ICG units at first available opportunity. (m) The second party will take necessary action for any misconduct or disobedience by the drivers to any law enforcing agencies. (n) The drivers may carry their packed meals and allowed half an hour lunch break. (p) The second party will be responsible for the personal/administrative needs of the drivers like, re sts, payments, refreshment, medical or other such requirement which may affect the quality of the service rendered by the contractor the first party will not be bound to consider these factors while assessing performance of the second party with regards to driver’s conduct. (q) Driver should be medically fit for driving duty. They should not have illness, infectious disease r eporting for duty. (r) The drivers will report any problems to the contractor only. Drivers will not report any problem i n any case to Coast Guard Official at any circumstances.

(s) General terms and condition regarding timing, appearance of vehicles/ condition, place of duty, driver uniform/ disciplines etc. and other general terms and information are mentioned. 27. The PDF file uploaded should be readable and shall not be password protected. * PDF of documents should be uploaded as follows: - (a) Valid documentary proof of geographical presence of consignee location i.e Andhra Pradesh, Visakhapa tnam. (b) GST Certificate, Valid Labour Registration Certificate of Consignee location i.e. (Andhra Pradesh , Visakhapatnam). (c) Attested copy of the audited balance sheets (audited by Chartered Accountant) for the completed three financial year i.e. 2023-24 ,2024-25 and 2025- 26. (d) Experience document of 03 years for providing manpower services in Ministries /Departments under Government of India. (e) Firms turn over document. NOTE: - Upload only above mentioned documents. Extra uploaded documents shall result in di squalification. GUIDELINES FOR TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR OUT SOURCING OF SERVICES OF MTDs 1. Age. The outsourced MTDs shall not be below the age of 21 years or above 50 years th 2. Education. It is desirable that the driver has qualified minimum 10 standard pass. 3. Driving license. Drivers must be of Indian nationality having valid driving license of HMV (Heavy Motor Vehicle). The outsourced MTD should always carry original valid driving license whilst on duty. In ca se any penalty is levied by the police and other law enforcement authorities for not carrying original valid driving license by driver, the penalty shall be borne by the service provider. 4. Driving Experience. Driver should have minimum 03 years’ experience to drive HMV and other releva nt vehicle foe which services of outsourced drivers are being solicited.

5. Clean Driving Record. The personnel engaged by the service provider for driving should not have any adverse Police record/ criminal cases in the past pending against them. 6. Medical Fitness. The service provider shall ensure that the outsourced MTDs deployed are medically fi t and their periodic medical examination is conducted. The driver should produce medical certificate for driving LMV/HMV or other concerned vehicles from Govt Hospital. The format for medical fitness certificate will be provided after award of contract. 7. Knowledge of Traffic Rules and Regulations. The outsourced MTD should have through knowledge of road safety rules and traffic regulation wherein the driver must always follow all the traffic rule str ictly. In case any penalty rules by drivers, the penalty shall be borne by the service provider. 8. Antecedents Verification. The service provider shall ensure good character, conduct and behavior of the personnel deployed for driving duties. The character and antecedents of each personnel engage d in driving duties shall be verified by the service provider at own cost after due investigation by the local police, collecting proofs of identity like driving license, bank account, details, previous work exp erience, proof of residence, recent photograph etc. and a certificate of this office be submitted to the ICG prior to commencement of the contract. 9. Vehicle Maintenance Knowledge. Driver should have good knowledge of petrol/diesel engine vehicle s including EVs enabling the fault location and rectification of minor defects. Driver should have basi c knowledge of maintenance of vehicles and should be able to replace flat/punctured tyres on their o wn. 10. Replacement of Civilian Driver. The outsourced MTDs will have to be duly authorized for driving dut y by the Coast Guard authority for whome the service vehicles have been sanctioned. Any replacem ent of outsourced drivers due to any reason to be timely communicated to the user unit by giving an application 15 days in advance. The contractor shall ensure that unwanted replacement/ change of driver within 06 months of employment to be avoided unless warranted by various provisions of the contract concluded. The contractor shall change the civilian driver within 24 hrs if the concerned per son commits any of the following: - i. Any act of Disobedience ii. Negligent performance of duty iii. Sleeping while on duty iv. Any act of dishonesty (v) Indulging in illegal activity which may jeopardize the interests of the Govt. of India and u ser unit. vi. Any other misconduct (vii) Consumption of alcohol or any other drugs while on duty or in the premises of duty pl aces.

11. Uniform. Particular attention shall be paid to the turnout of the MTDs as same will also reflect on the i mage of the organization in Government, Military and civil areas. The civilian driver deployed by the contractor shall adorn well stitched and ironed uniform (white shirt & grey trouser with leather belt a nd leather shoes) during duty hours. In order to maintain neat and clean uniform at all times at least two set of uniforms to be issued to employees by the contractor at a time to all drivers within 15 day s post award of contract and one set of dress issued after six months. 12. Accident/ Untoward Incident. (i) The service provider shall be entirely responsible for the protection of Government vehicle in the event of any accident. The service provider shall indemnify the ICG from any liability of legal mat ters arising out of dispute or accident with a third party. ICG shall not be responsible in any manner whatsoever in matters of injury/death/health deterioration etc. of the outsourced d rivers performing duties under the contract. (ii) In case of any incident/ accident during the operation of the Govt. vehicle by the outsourced MTD, the I CG will not be held responsible for the same. In eventuality of any litigation due to acciden t, the service provider shall handle the same at own cost and in the event wherein ICG hap pens to incur any expenditure towards litigation, the same shall be recovered from the ser vice provider. Miscellaneous 13. The service provider should not have been black listed by any Government or non-Government organi zation in last 05 years. 14. In case of any driver is found unfit on account of insubordination / misconduct, services may be termin ated immediately without any prior notice. 15. The workforce deployed by the contractor shall be the employee of the contractor and in no circumsta nces shall ever have any claim of employment with the ICG. 16. The contractor shall be responsible for all commissions and omissions on part of personnel engaged for the driving duties. 17. The contractor shall be obliged and solely responsible to comply with all statutory security requiremen ts in respect of the personnel engaged by the firm and ICG shall not be party to any dispute arising o ut of such deployment by the contractor. 18 The ICG shall not be liable for any loss, damage, theft, burglary or robbery of any personal belongings, equipment of vehicles of the personnel of the service provider. The ICG shall also not be liable for an y claims/ financial disbursement to any person employed by the service provider in the course of the performance of their assigned duties, or for payment towards any resultant compensation an the fin e/ challan towards the same shall be borne by the service provider.

19 That the service provider on its Part and through own resources shall ensure that the good, material an d equipment, etc. are not damaged in the process of carrying out the driving duties. Service provider shall ensure that no equipment, machinery or any part of the vehicle is removed/ damaged by the o utsourced MTD. In case damage is sustained whilst the vehicles are being driven by outsourced MTD s the onus of bearing expenses towards repair of such damage will be solely lie on the contractor. 20 During the period of engagement with the ICG, it is likely that outsourced MTDs may come across certai n information of importance or of secret nature. The shall in no case represent or give opinion or giv e advice to other in any matter which the adverse to the interest of the office except in the due disc harge of the tasks assigned to them as driver. More importantly, they will not divulge any informatio n gathered by them during the period of their assignment to anyone who is not authorized to know/ have the same. 21 The outsourced MTD shall have to work at assigned duty place and should be ready to perform duties a nywhere in the area prescribed by the contractor operating authority. . 9. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider
